detailed_descriptions.en: Nevergrind is set in the world of Vandamor, a land inhabited by orcs, giants and dragons! Battle against the dark forces that have sewn chaos and destruction throughout the world. Nevergrind’s gameplay is focused on fighting battles and completing quest objectives throughout four acts. When you first start out, you’re just a recruit helping secure the perimeter of Edenburg. Your commander, Miranda Crossheart, sees your potential and keeps you busy with more difficult quests. This leads to your first boss encounter at Lanfeld Outpost, Chief Grimden. In a similar fashion, each act climaxes with a tough boss battle through which more of the game’s story is unveiled to the player. Key Features ⚔️ Streamlined Combat: High-speed, real-time battles! No time wasted on travel or boring fetch quests! 🔥 Chain Combo System: Master the rhythm of battle to skyrocket your XP, Gold, and Magic Find! 🌲 Class Depth: Blend 12 unique talents per class to customize your hero’s strengths! 💎 Loot Hunter’s Paradise: Over 900 unique items and 28 powerful gear sets to discover! 👹 Epic Boss Trials: Face off against legendary foes across four story-driven acts! Treasure-Hunting Treasure-finding is a key feature of Nevergrind’s gameplay. Finding rare, powerful items is the best way to make your character more powerful. Since loot is so important in this type of game, a great deal of time and energy was spent designing exciting items. In addition to items with randomized properties, there are over 900 uniquely designed items that can be discovered. You can even find items from 28 different sets which provide passive bonuses as you equip more pieces! Chain Combos The combat system also rewards competence! The chain combo system is a core game mechanic which boosts your hero's rewards! Completing chain combos is a great way to increase experience gained, gold find, and magic find! A chain combo is achieved by killing consecutive monsters without leaving combat. Racking up a huge chain combo requires smart equipment decisions, understanding of the item properties, and a masterful understanding of your hero's strengths and weaknesses! You can even boost your rewards by fighting multiple enemies at once! Taking on big risks leads to big rewards!

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Nevergrind is set in the world of Vandamor, a land inhabited by orcs, giants and dragons! Battle against the dark forces that have sewn chaos and destruction throughout the world. Nevergrind’s gameplay is focused on fighting battles and completing quest objectives throughout four acts. When you first start out, you’re just a recruit helping secure the perimeter of Edenburg. Your commander, Miranda Crossheart, sees your potential and keeps you busy with more difficult quests. This leads to your first boss encounter at Lanfeld Outpost, Chief Grimden. In a similar fashion, each act climaxes with a tough boss battle through which more of the game’s story is unveiled to the player.

Key Features

  • ⚔️ Streamlined Combat: High-speed, real-time battles! No time wasted on travel or boring fetch quests!

  • 🔥 Chain Combo System: Master the rhythm of battle to skyrocket your XP, Gold, and Magic Find!

  • 🌲 Class Depth: Blend 12 unique talents per class to customize your hero’s strengths!

  • 💎 Loot Hunter’s Paradise: Over 900 unique items and 28 powerful gear sets to discover!

  • 👹 Epic Boss Trials: Face off against legendary foes across four story-driven acts!

Treasure-Hunting

Treasure-finding is a key feature of Nevergrind’s gameplay. Finding rare, powerful items is the best way to make your character more powerful. Since loot is so important in this type of game, a great deal of time and energy was spent designing exciting items. In addition to items with randomized properties, there are over 900 uniquely designed items that can be discovered. You can even find items from 28 different sets which provide passive bonuses as you equip more pieces!

Chain Combos

The combat system also rewards competence! The chain combo system is a core game mechanic which boosts your hero's rewards! Completing chain combos is a great way to increase experience gained, gold find, and magic find! A chain combo is achieved by killing consecutive monsters without leaving combat. Racking up a huge chain combo requires smart equipment decisions, understanding of the item properties, and a masterful understanding of your hero's strengths and weaknesses! You can even boost your rewards by fighting multiple enemies at once! Taking on big risks leads to big rewards!
